content.text: ­ Navigation Menu+ The Ultimate Guide to St John Beaches Your mobile-friendly St John island guide to St John's beaches, snorkeling, maps and more. Whether you want to enjoy the North Shore's Trunk Bay, Cinnamon Bay, Maho Beach and Caneel Bay beaches or favor the solitude of a beach that's off the beaten path - like a "secret" beach, Lameshur, Haulover Bay and Salt Pond Bay - this guide has it all. Enjoy! Where is St John island? St John is the smallest of the 3 US Virgin Islands located in the Caribbean. The island measures just 9 mi X 3 mi ( 28 sq mi ). 2/3 of the island and surrounding reefs are protected by the US Virgin Islands National Park [ VINP ]. Read More > How do I get to St John island? 99.9% of travelers come to St John by boat ! St John has no airport. There are busy ferry routes that connect St John to St Thomas, St Croix, Tortola and the BVIs. The most popular ferries are out of Charlotte Amalie and Red Hook, St Thomas. All rights reserved. Where is St John St John is the smallest of the (3) United States Virgin Islands. The other 2 islands being St Thomas and St Croix. St John is located a few short miles off St Thomas’ eastern shore – and can be reached by ferry service leaving from Charlotte Amalie or Red Hook, St Thomas and arriving in St John’s main port of Cruz Bay. Click here for St Thomas to St John ferry information Where are the Virgin Islands? The Virgin Islands are a chain of islands in the Caribbean just east of Puerto Rico. Mobile-friendly Google map of St John and St Thomas View Where is St John in a larger map Do I need a passport to travel to St John? A: No, St John is a US territory so a US passport is not required to travel to the island. However, traveling with a passport can make your entry to the States quicker and it allows you the option to travel to islands like Jost Van Dyke, Tortola and the Baths on Virgin Gorda which are located in the British Virgin Islands (BVIs).
